data.value: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu techniques organised by belt, category and position. Search by name or synonym and filter according to what you train today.

data.name: Tecnicas.Intro.Blanco
data.value: You work on the fundamentals: posture, basic escapes and survival positions. Prioritise safe technique and understanding each concept over speed.

data.name: Tecnicas.Intro.Azul
data.value: You consolidate the base and start chaining attacks and defences. Prioritise transitions between positions and control of the opponent.

data.name: Tecnicas.Intro.Violeta
data.value: You develop a more offensive game with attacks from guard and submissions. Prioritise the precision of the locks and the timing.

data.name: Tecnicas.Intro.Marrón
data.value: You refine your technique and start reading the opponent's game. Prioritise efficiency, detail and decision making.

data.name: Tecnicas.Intro.Negro
data.value: You master the fine details and adapt your game to every opponent. Prioritise fluidity, your own game and fixing root mistakes.

data.name: Ayuda.Descripcion
data.value: A quick guide to Mi Camino BJJ: what the application is, how to register, how to use the technique library, the Practitioner's Guide and your profile. We only describe what is already available.

data.name: Ayuda.QueEs.P1
data.value: Mi Camino BJJ is a web application to practise Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: it brings together a technique library with cards, videos and filters, a Practitioner's Guide that answers questions about those techniques, and a personal profile with your name, your belt and your photo.

data.name: Ayuda.QueEs.P2
data.value: Your belt is a profile detail: it personalises the experience and the Guide's suggestions, but it never defines permissions inside the application.

data.name: Ayuda.Registro.Titulo
data.value: How to register and sign in

data.name: Ayuda.Registro.L1
data.value: Go to the home page and press «Sign up now!» (or the «Register» link in the top bar).

data.name: Ayuda.Registro.L2
data.value: Fill in the form: name, email, current belt and a password of at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character.

data.name: Ayuda.Registro.L3
data.value: When you register, your account is created with the Practicante role. The system assigns the role: it cannot be chosen from the form.

data.name: Ayuda.Registro.L4
data.value: Sign in with your email and password from «Sign in». The session belongs to the application: closing the browser closes it too.

data.name: Ayuda.Registro.L5
data.value: Once you are in, your avatar (top right) opens the account menu with «My profile», «Settings», «Help» and «Sign out».

data.name: Ayuda.Biblioteca.Titulo
data.value: How to use the technique library

data.name: Ayuda.Biblioteca.P1
data.value: The library is at «Technique library», in the top bar. It lists the available techniques ordered by belt and, for each one, you can open its card with the step-by-step description, its videos and related techniques.

data.name: Ayuda.Biblioteca.L1
data.value: Search by name or synonym: type the technique name (for example «kimura» or «RNC») in the search box. The search also recognises the alternative name you know it by in your academy.

data.name: Ayuda.Biblioteca.L2
data.value: Filter: combine the belt, category and position filters and press «Search».

data.name: Ayuda.Biblioteca.L3
data.value: White belt journey: when you filter by the white belt, the access to the educational journey appears, with modules and cards ordered to progress step by step.

data.name: Ayuda.Cinturon.L1
data.value: At the top of the library there is the «Filter by belt» block: pick a belt with a single click or go back to «All».

data.name: Ayuda.Cinturon.L2
data.value: When you pick one, the list is filtered and a short introduction with the context of that belt is shown.

data.name: Ayuda.Cinturon.L3
data.value: The filter combines with the text search and with the category and position filters: all criteria apply at once.

data.name: Ayuda.Videos.L1
data.value: Open the technique card (for example, from the list or from the Guide).

data.name: Ayuda.Videos.L2
data.value: In the videos section you will see the thumbnail with the ▶ button: pressing it loads the player and the video starts playing.

data.name: Ayuda.Videos.L3
data.value: Below you have the «Open on YouTube ↗» link, which opens the video in another tab.

data.name: Ayuda.Videos.Nota
data.value: Videos are uploaded by the library administrators. If a technique has no video associated yet, its card shows the description without a player.

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.Titulo
data.value: How to use the AI Practitioner's Guide

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.P1
data.value: The Practitioner's Guide is in the top bar and requires signing in. It is a conversation: you type your question (up to 1000 characters) and you get an answer about the techniques in the library.

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.L1
data.value: Real mode on screen: the chat label tells you whether you are using the generative AI assistant or the catalog-based guide (the mode that works when the AI service is unavailable). The answer always states its origin: the catalog is never presented as AI.

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.L2
data.value: Suggested questions: below the chat there are buttons with frequently asked questions («What is a guard?», «Show me white belt techniques», etc.) that you can tap to send the query.

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.L3
data.value: Belt level: the Guide uses the belt on your profile to suggest techniques at your level.

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.L4
data.value: Shortcuts: Enter sends the question and Shift+Enter inserts a line break.

data.name: Ayuda.Guia.Nota
data.value: The Guide is a study companion: always practise under your instructor's supervision and never force a joint lock on a training partner.

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.P1
data.value: Open «My profile» from your avatar menu (top right). On that same screen you can:

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.L1
data.value: See your photo at medium size (120 × 120 px, with rounded corners). If you have not uploaded one yet, an avatar with your initials is shown.

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.L2
data.value: Upload or change your photo: choose the file and press «Save changes». JPG, PNG or WEBP images up to 2 MB are accepted; the application checks the type and the real content of the file before saving it.

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.L3
data.value: Edit your name (it is the name the rest of the application shows).

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.L4
data.value: Edit your current belt by picking one of the belts in the catalogue (white, blue, purple, brown or black).

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.L5
data.value: Check your email, your role and your registration date: they are read-only.

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.P2
data.value: When you finish the changes, press «Save changes»: the screen confirms that the changes were saved.

data.name: Ayuda.Perfil.Nota
data.value: The email is the key to your account and the role is assigned by the system: that is why they are not editable from the profile.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D1
data.value: Can I change my email or my role?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R1
data.value: No. The email identifies your account and the system assigns the role when you register.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D2
data.value: Does changing my belt give me permissions?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R2
data.value: No. The belt only personalises the experience and the Guide's suggestions.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D3
data.value: What happens if I upload an image that is too heavy or is not an image?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R3
data.value: It is not saved: the application validates the size (2 MB maximum), the extension and the real content of the file, and tells you the reason.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D4
data.value: Can I see someone else's photo?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R4
data.value: No. Every photo is private: only its owner can see it.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D5
data.value: Does the Guide answer any question?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R5
data.value: It focuses on the techniques in the library and on your level. If the AI service is unavailable, it answers in catalog mode and says so.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D6
data.value: I forgot my password, what do I do?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R6
data.value: There is no automatic password recovery today: ask an administrator to reset your credential.

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.D7
data.value: Where do I see my progress or my saved training sessions?

data.name: Ayuda.Faq.R7
data.value: The training log and the progress tracking are not available in the web version yet; they are shown as «Coming soon» on the home page.

data.name: Ayuda.Cta.P1
data.value: Check the library and the Practitioner's Guide: the answer is usually there. And remember to always practise with supervision.
